# Qum

Qum is a Mac app that puts the next prayer, the Qibla, and the adhan in the MacBook notch.

- Home: https://hayyaqum.com/
- What Qum is: https://hayyaqum.com/about
- Privacy: https://hayyaqum.com/privacy
- Email: hello@hayyaqum.com

Requires a MacBook with a notch: MacBook Pro (2021 or later) or MacBook Air (2022 or later). Other Macs have no notch for Qum to sit in.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Prayer times, the Qibla, the prayer log, and settings stay on this Mac. A coordinate or a city name may go to Apple Location Services so Qum can name or resolve a place — that is the only data that leaves this Mac.

Qum is not an iPhone app and not a menu-bar timer. Menu-bar prayer apps keep a countdown in the status bar on any Mac. Qum uses the notch, plays the adhan there, and keeps the streak on this Mac.

No Mac can measure heading. Qum shows Qibla direction from the desk after a one-time calibration.
